SELECT (SELECT count(store_code) FROM store WHERE user_code = #{userCode}) AS greenfireCount, (SELECT count(challenge_part_code) FROM challenge_part WHERE user_code = #{userCode}) AS challengeCount, (SELECT count(post_code) FROM post WHERE user_code = #{userCode}) AS feedCount, (SELECT count(target_user) FROM user_follows WHERE user_code = #{userCode}) AS friendCount

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ch.challenge_code as challengeCode, ch.challenge_title as challengeTitle, ch.challenge_content, ch.thumbnail_url as thumbnail, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ch.created_at) AS rn FROM challenge_part cp LEFT JOIN challenge ch ON cp.challenge_code = ch.challenge_code WHERE cp.user_code = #{userCode} ) t WHERE t.rn <= 3
